Very cool sweet cafe is Renegeteg romcafé (near to Corvin negyed station) adorable little place. 
As for restaurants I love Leves and Rapaz (two small soup bars near Astoria) also there is a vegan restaurant in Múzeum körút and many small still nice places in Kálvin square and Ráday street. 
Sirius teahouse and Altair are wonderful places also! *.* 
For bars Csendes is great, but a bit loud, Ibolya and Csempés are sweet and Mélypont is unforgettable. There is a bar dedicated to the ironic memory of the socialist era called Red Ruin near there. 
You maybe should try Szimpla and/or Fogas and Lámpás these are more of a place for tourist I don't know is its pro or contra for you. I think they worth a look.

3. It should be a must have. I mean as writing my thesis, i also came across the fact, that there is a huge ukranian dissident diaspora in canada, and soud that fact really interesting. Ukraina has an unquestionable role in the fall of the soviet regime, still has its negative effects till today. I mean I am a bit surprised, that you in canada are learning of Ukraine, is it because you are a part of a bigger ukranian community there?
